name: core-move-breach
description: Rules audit (core, TI4_MOVE_CHECK): systems with active breaches are adjacent to each other (Thunder's Edge, Crimson Rebellion), and the move check counts that (CheckDistanceHelper / FoWHelper breach adjacency). Base pbd117@45 (Crimson in the game): active breaches at 301 and in the Crimson home (br); Arborec activates br and moves a cruiser (move 2) from 301 - accepted (1 system away through the breach).
